description: pixel art, top-down view straight from above of frozen ground in eternal night: packed snow and patches of black ice, thin frost cracks, scattered small dark stones, muted very dark palette of icy blue, black and pale grey, a faint pale strip of trampled ground across the middle dividing two halves, slightly darker edges, soft even dusk light, flat ground seen from above for a dim background behind game cards, very low contrast, no standing trees, no people, no animals, no weapons, no text, no border
